name: approval
purpose: Request a decision and explicitly handle its lifecycle
generatedFlows: One enclosing flow per workflowRecipes resource; child references resolve to separately declared solution flows
risk: Propagated from every primitive and transitive child
longRunningBehavior: Create returns immediately; createAndWait/startAndWait have explicit bounded timeouts
idempotencyRequirements: Explicit intent; optional atomic Dataverse primary-key ledger
outputs: creation identity or scoped normalized approval result
